P-01.what_exists_now: Computational model + svMultiPhysics 3D verification (16% 1D-3D agreement). TTP assembled.
P-01.what_is_modelled: 30% revision rate reduction, $124M/yr value. 24h survival (both designs fail ~14h).
P-01.what_is_demonstrated: 1D vs 3D agreement. 225 ablations. Dual-invariant falsified honestly.

buyer_value.problem: Catheter obstruction = 30-50% of shunt failures. $35-50K per revision.
buyer_value.integration_burden: HIGH — requires multi-segment catheter + flow sensor (not commercially available)

P-01.buyer_action: LICENSE — reproduce computation, then commission V0 bench ($3-5K)

buyer_value.integration_burden: MEDIUM — valve modification, no new sensor

P-02.buyer_action: COMMISSION TEST — bench: adaptive vs fixed ($10-20K, 2-4 weeks)

P-04.what_exists_now: Computational model (100% Aβ clearance MODELLED). NEP enzyme selected. 4/8 engineering frozen.

buyer_value.problem: Aβ accumulation in CSF of Alzheimer's patients with shunts

P-04.buyer_action: COMMISSION TEST — in vitro: NEP + Aβ42 ($15-30K, 4-6 weeks)

P-07.what_exists_now: Mechanism defined (extracted from P-04). P-03's floor was falsified (too small).
P-07.what_is_demonstrated: Nothing physical. P-03 (related concept) was falsified.
P-07.buyer_action: COMMISSION TEST — bench: obstruction with/without floor ($5-10K)

P-10.what_is_modelled: 0.34s response time. Thermal scaling from n-eicosane failure.

buyer_value.problem: Valve response too slow for rapid ICP changes

P-10.buyer_action: COMMISSION TEST — bench: n-octadecane valve ($5-10K, 3-4 weeks)

P-11.what_exists_now: Evidence chain (phage K + Ti + electrospun). Computational model.

buyer_value.problem: Infection = 8-12% of shunt failures, $40-80K per case
buyer_value.commercial_route: License to shunt OEM with biologics capability

P-11.buyer_action: COMMISSION TEST — in vitro: biofilm assay ($10-20K, 3-4 weeks)

P-12.what_exists_now: Computational model (100% tau clearance MODELLED). Cathepsin D selected.
P-12.buyer_action: COMMISSION TEST — in vitro: tau clearance ($15-25K, 4-6 weeks)

P-13.what_exists_now: ML model designed. No real patient data tested.
P-13.what_is_modelled: AUC and lead time (not yet measured).

buyer_value.buyer: Hospital system / shunt OEM with clinical data
buyer_value.problem: Shunt failure prediction is reactive (symptoms then surgery)
buyer_value.integration_burden: MEDIUM — requires data pipeline + ML infrastructure
buyer_value.commercial_route: License to hospital system or data company

P-13.buyer_action: COMMISSION TEST — provide clinical dataset for retrospective validation ($5-15K)

buyer_value.problem: Battery replacement requires surgery every 5-8 years

P-15.buyer_action: LICENSE — reproduce computation, then bench: harvesting measurement ($5-10K)

P-16.what_is_modelled: ~1050 μW power output (verified range, not single number).
P-16.what_is_demonstrated: Independent MC verification (PyTissueOptics, different author). CIs overlap.

buyer_value.integration_burden: MEDIUM — PV cell + LED + tissue interface

P-16.buyer_action: LICENSE — reproduce MC, then bench: LED + phantom + PV ($2-5K)

P-20.what_exists_now: Computational model (IL-10 release 2468 ng/cm²/day). 4/4 attacks survived. Decision tree.
P-20.what_is_modelled: IL-10 release kinetics. Glycan surface density.
P-20.buyer_action: COMMISSION TEST — in vitro: IL-10 release 30 days ($5-10K, 6-8 weeks)

P-21.what_exists_now: Computational UWB attenuation model (6.5 GHz, 38.5 dB margin). SIMPLIFIED — homogeneous tissue.
P-21.what_is_modelled: Signal attenuation through scalp+skull+dura. Link margin.
P-21.what_is_demonstrated: Nothing. Model is simplified — no anatomical variability, no SAR, no localization accuracy.

buyer_value.problem: Catheter migration = 5-10% of failures. Detection requires CT/MRI.
buyer_value.integration_burden: HIGH — UWB through skull unproven, regulatory complex
buyer_value.commercial_route: License to imaging or shunt OEM

P-21.buyer_action: COMMISSION TEST — computational: frequency sweep + anatomical variability + phantom validation

P-22.what_exists_now: Computational SMP actuation model (force margin vs Stokes drag). SIMPLIFIED — no tissue contact, friction, bending.
P-22.what_is_modelled: SMP recovery force vs CSF drag. Force margin.
P-22.what_is_demonstrated: Nothing. Model is simplified — Stokes drag is not the full navigation problem.

buyer_value.problem: Suboptimal catheter placement = 3-5% of failures. Repositioning requires surgery.
buyer_value.integration_burden: VERY HIGH — SMP in CSF, control system, safety

P-22.buyer_action: COMMISSION TEST — computational: full navigation model (stiffness + friction + buckling + control)
